001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.delta.IIntDeltaMonitor;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.delta.ISetDeltaMonitor;
011import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.IntEventType;
012import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.SetEventType;
013import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
014import org.chocosolver.util.procedure.IntProcedure;
015
016/**
017 *
018 * @author jimmy
019 */
020public class PropSingleton extends Propagator<Variable> {
021
022    private final IntVar i;
023    private final IIntDeltaMonitor iD;
024    private final SetVar s;
025    private final ISetDeltaMonitor sD;
026
027    public PropSingleton(IntVar ivar, SetVar svar) {
028        super(new Variable[]{ivar, svar}, PropagatorPriority.UNARY, true);
029        this.i = ivar;
030        this.iD = i.monitorDelta(this);
031        this.s = svar;
032        this.sD = s.monitorDelta(this);
033    }
034
035    private boolean isIVar(int idx) {
036        return idx == 0;
037    }
038
039    private boolean isSVar(int idx) {
040        return idx == 1;
041    }
042
043    @Override
044    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
045        if (isIVar(vIdx)) {
046            return IntEventType.all();
047        }
048        assert isSVar(vIdx);
049        return SetEventType.all();
050    }
051
052    @Override
053    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
054        if (s.getLB().size() > 1) {
055            fails();
056        } else if (s.getLB().size() == 1) {
057            int val = s.getLB().min();
058            i.instantiateTo(val, this);
059            s.instantiateTo(new int[]{val}, this);
060        } else {
061            PropUtil.domSubsetEnv(i, s, this);
062            PropUtil.envSubsetDom(s, i, this);
063            if (i.isInstantiated()) {
064                s.instantiateTo(new int[]{i.getValue()}, this);
065            }
066        }
067        iD.startMonitoring();
068        sD.startMonitoring();
069    }
070
071    @Override
072    public void propagate(int idxVarInProp, int mask) throws ContradictionException {
073        if (isIVar(idxVarInProp)) {
074            if (i.isInstantiated()) {
075                s.instantiateTo(new int[]{i.getValue()}, this);
076            } else {
077                iD.forEachRemVal((IntProcedure) rem -> s.remove(rem, this));
078            }
079        } else {
080            assert isSVar(idxVarInProp);
081            int sKerSize = s.getLB().size();
082            if (sKerSize > 1) {
083                fails();
084            } else if (sKerSize == 1) {
085                int val = s.getLB().min();
086                i.instantiateTo(val, this);
087                s.instantiateTo(new int[]{val}, this);
088            } else {
089                sD.forEach(env -> i.removeValue(env, this), SetEventType.REMOVE_FROM_ENVELOPE);
090                if (i.isInstantiated()) {
091                    s.instantiateTo(new int[]{i.getValue()}, this);
092                }
093            }
094        }
095    }
096
097    @Override
098    public ESat isEntailed() {
099        int lb = s.getLB().size();
100        if (lb > 1) {
101            return ESat.FALSE;
102        }
103        if (lb == 1) {
104            if (i.contains(s.getLB().min())) {
105                return i.isInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
106            } else {
107                return ESat.FALSE;
108            }
109        }
110        if (s.getUB().size() < 1) {
111            return ESat.FALSE;
112        }
113        if (PropUtil.isDomIntersectEnv(i, s)) {
114            return i.isInstantiated() && s.isInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
115        }
116        return ESat.FALSE;
117    }
118
119    @Override
120    public String toString() {
121        return "singleton({" + i + "} = " + s + ")";
122    }
123}
